Name: Croakets - Carrot and Far Away Stone Replacer
Author: SharkTeethy
Description:
I'm not sure that this mod will appeal to anyone but my brother, but he requested I upload it anyway so he can use it. This is a very silly mod that replaces carrots with "croakets" and turns the far away stone (the item, the statue, and the sword) into frogs.

This mod was a very good test of my abilities and I learned a lot while creating it. 🐸

Downloads.Description: Turns carrots into croakets and far away stones into frogs. Like a witch!
